title: Soviet Phobos probe's last image before shutdown
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Soviet Phobos probe's last image before shutdown, about 1989 at Phobos, Mars, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote:
The last image shows an object like
a fin on the tail of a plane, it
looks like it's in the photo.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that in 1989 a Soviet space probe sent to Phobos, a small moon of Mars, took a final picture before it stopped working. According to Michels, that last image shows an object shaped like the fin on the tail of a plane. He tells it because, if true, it would suggest something unexplained near Mars was caught on camera just as the probe went silent.
